name: Gmina Piątek (Poland)
description: Dark blue field with a yellow horizontal bar across the lower half, continuing from the charge from the gmina arms at the hoist: a yellow cross between three white fleurs-de-lis.
history: Established by resolution No. IV/26/02 of the gmina council of 30 December 2002, designed by Marek Adamczewski.

features.role: cross from the gmina arms and bar across the field
three fleurs-de-lis from the gmina arms
